name: Beyond Frames Entertainment AB (publ)
summary: Beyond Frames Entertainment AB (publ), a Swedish company, specializes in the development and publication of video games. Its core business involves creating interactive experiences centered around virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) technologies. Established in 2014, the firm's main offices are situated in Stockholm, Sweden. It operates as a subsidiary of Cortopia AB.
